messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: Triggered P1 - GPU_MEM_PRESSURE on pool `shared-infer-1` (us-east-1). Affected nodes: infer-12, infer-15. Symptoms: NVML OOM / high GPU utilization. Alert: https://pagerduty.example/alerts/PD-9a8b7c

pagerduty: Alert PD-9a8b7c is firing (service: gpu-inference).

Joe Park: acked, I'm on it. starting triage. pinging Ana.

Ana Gomez: on call, joining triage. checking dashboards (latency + evictions).

Joe Park: quick check: `nvidia-smi -L` and process list on infer-12
```
GPU 0: A100-SXM4 (UUID: GPU-abc123)
Processes: 
  2312 python /opt/infer/server.py --model=gpt-70b
  2401 worker (batcher)
Memory use: 98%
```

Priya Singh: `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep infer-12` shows heavy pods: `infer-gpt-70b-0` on infer-12, `kv-prefetcher` also present.

Mark Li: looks like KV prefetcher kept pinned large tensors. Suggest: drain node, evict non-critical pods, and re-route traffic to `backup-infer` pool.

Joe Park: running cordon + drain on infer-12 now: `kubectl cordon infer-12 && kubectl drain infer-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force`

Infra SRE: FYI, kernel logs show repeated `CUDA: out of memory` and `nv-hostengine` messages on infer-15. Might be fragmentation + long-running traces.

Ana Gomez: can we temporarily lower batch sizes or fallback models for affected routes? We have a canary route to `gpt-70b-quant` and `gpt-13b` as fallback. Recommend switching autopolicy to prefer `backup-infer` + downgraded model.

Joe Park: applied routing override for customer-facing route `/v1/generate` -> prefer `backup-infer` (takes effect in 18s).

pagerduty: Alert PD-9a8b7c acknowledged by Joe Park.

Priya Singh: customer impact: Acme.ai showing elevated 503s between 17:02-17:08. CS bot pinged them with ETA.

customer-success-bot: Contacted Acme.ai support channel, message sent: "We're investigating GPU pressure in us-east-1; temporary route change applied. We'll follow up with timeline."

Mark Li: confirm: infer-12 drained, pods rescheduled to backup pool but one job failed eviction (stateful). Restarting job with scaled resources.

Joe Park: infer-15 still noisy. I'm going to kill the long-lived `kv-prefetcher` process on infer-15 to free memory, will monitor.

Ana Gomez: do it, and also flip the prefetcher config to `max_cache_bytes=0.6` for the pool. Send the config patch here.

Joe Park: patch applied: `PATCH /config/pools/shared-infer-1 {"kv_prefetch": {"max_cache_bytes": 6442450944}}`

Infra SRE: kernel OOM logs tapering off after prefetcher kill. NVML memory usage dropping to ~40%.

Priya Singh: metrics look stable, error rate for Acme.ai back down to normal. Marking customer impact as mitigated, will follow up with RCA.

Ana Gomez: opened incident ticket IN-2026 for full RCA + follow-up actions (auto-evict thresholds, prefetch config defaults). Assigning to Mark + Infra SRE.

Joe Park: nice work team. leaving routing override in place for 30m. please signal if any regressions. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident IN-2026 created from PD-9a8b7c. Runbook link: https://docs.redwood/inference/runbooks/gpu-mem-pressure

pagerduty: PD-9a8b7c resolved (status: closed)

Ana Gomez: postmortem action items: 1) lower default prefetch cap for shared-infer pools 2) add automated eviction for pinned KV > 75% 3) autoscale backup pool at 60% cluster evict threshold.

Joe Park: closing thread after logs archived. thanks."
